Attribute.Name: Internal Source Record Creation: Enrichment Handling

MetaData.Value: By default, the Internal Source Record Creation Workflow is configured with multiple enrichment roles: The Copywriter user (Marketing Copy Group), the Digital Asset user (Image Group), and the Warehouse Data/Logistics user (Warehouse Group). However, smaller organizations may only have one role responsible for enrichment and therefore would want to funnel all enrichment tasks to a single queue rather than have them split into three. To accommodate this, Accelerator for Retail allows for changing the configuration from a multi-user enrichment setup to a single-user enrichment setup. When using the single-user enrichment setup, the enrichment user(s) must be a member of the Enrichment Group (PMDM.UG.EnrichmentGroup) user group.
